_comment: Who lives in the dungeons. Gear with a 'weak' tag hits harder (+30% of its power); weapons with a 'resist' tag hit softer (-30%). Loot is what adventurers bring back after beating them.

goblins.name: Goblin Horde
goblins.desc: Fast and numerous. Quick blades and arrows cut them down.

wolves.name: Dire Wolves
wolves.desc: Hunt in packs. Keep them at range; beast charms calm them.

skeletons.name: Restless Skeletons
skeletons.desc: Arrows and edges pass between their ribs. Smash them or use silver.

wraiths.name: Wailing Wraiths
wraiths.desc: Spirits. Only silver and magic truly touch them.

trolls.name: Fen Trolls
trolls.desc: Their wounds close unless burned. Axes chop through the hide.

elementals.name: Ember Elementals
elementals.desc: Living flame. Fire-warding charms keep heroes alive; magic unbinds them.

golems.name: Mithril Golems
golems.desc: Walking ore. Crush them with hammers and maces, or dispel them.
